elena: Quick heads-up — all-hands this Friday 9:00am PT (Zoom link in calendar). Agenda below, please drop any Qs here and we’ll collect for the live QA. :sparkles:

elena: Agenda (tentative):
```
- 9:00 - 9:05: Quick company metrics + wins
- 9:05 - 9:20: Product roadmap highlight (Sana) — Dedicated v2 launch callout
- 9:20 - 9:35: Runtime & infra updates (Michael) — new autoscale policy + incident recap
- 9:35 - 9:45: People ops updates (Mina) — benefit changes + hiring plan
- 9:45 - 9:55: Q&A (live)
- 9:55 - 10:00: Close + action items
```

elena: Two quick asks: 1) If you have a sensitive question, DM me or Mina and we’ll bring it up anonymously. 2) If your team wants a 2-min demo slot, reply here with the one-line summary.

michael: FYI — I’ll cover the March 12 incident briefly (what happened, mitigations, follow-ups). No deep postmortem in all-hands, will link the full doc after.

sana: Product will call out Dedicated v2 rollout window and the new quantization profiles. We’ll include expected perf numbers and migration notes.

jordan: Quick marketing note — we’ll show a one-slide customer story for Dedicated v2. If you’ve got visuals, ping me.

mina: Reminder: open office hours for benefits Qs Thursday 11am. Also collecting input on parental leave policy language updates — DM me or add to the doc linked in the calendar invite.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: Scheduled infra maintenance on Thursday 2am PT — no customer-facing downtime expected.

elena: Please add your Qs here. Example: “How will Dedicated v2 impact existing Dedicated customers’ SLAs?” or “Any changes to on-call rotation?”

jordan: Can we also cover the new developer credits for early-stage startups in the brief? I can cover 45s.

elena: Yes, add that under wins — Jordan will do a quick mention.

person: demo-request: "Team ML infra — two-minute demo of batching dashboard"

michael: Noted on the incident: summarizing — GPU node oom triggered cascading fallback to lower-capacity cluster, causing 3-4m of elevated p95 for hosted. Root cause: kernel upgrade + a corner-case for KV cache flush. Fixes: pin kernel on affected images, better preflight for kernel upgrades, and a target to surface faster signals in the console (SRE action item).

elena: Thanks Mike — please add the incident postmortem link here after it's published.

recording-bot: Meeting scheduled: Friday 09:00 PT — Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.ai/ah-1766122334. Recording will be auto-posted here after the meeting.

-- (FRIDAY AFTER MEETING) --

recording-bot: Recording available: https://drive.redwood.ai/recordings/allhands-1766122334.mp4 (transcript attached).

michael: TL;DR takeaways from today: 1) Dedicated v2 rollout begins next week — migration path documented; 2) Incident follow-ups assigned to eng-infra + eng-sre with 2-week SLA for fixes; 3) Autoscale policy defaults updated to reduce cold-start spikes.

elena: Top-level actions: @sana publish migration guide by Tue EOD; @michael confirm kernel pins and post postmortem by Mon; @mina update parental leave copy and share with People Ops by next Fri.

mina: Will do. Also posting the benefits Q&A doc here: https://docs.redwood.ai/benefits/q-and-a

sana: Migration guide link: https://docs.redwood.ai/product/dedicated-v2-migration — feel free to PR changes.

jordan: Slides + customer story are in the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/slides/allhands-1766122334

elena: Thanks everyone — if there are any follow-ups that need exec attention, flag them in the thread and we’ll triage. :white_check_mark:
